description: FastSim 采集用 gem5 修改的整合清单。上游 gem5 + overlay(整文件新增) + patch(改上游文件) 可重建出与生产 gem5-fs 逐字一致的采集源码树。

env.TAOGEN_SHARED: <GEM5>/taogen/shared  # overlay 已自带这两个共享头, 指向 gem5 树内即可, 无需外部 taogen 目录

overlay.note: 整文件新增, 上游不存在, 不可用 patch 表达。含 taogen/shared 两个共享头(见 shared_headers), 已切断对外部 taogen 目录的编译期依赖

shared_headers.note: tao_trace.hh 与 mesi_ref_sim/simulator.hpp 共用的 µarch oracle 信源。原属 minesim 仓 taogen 分支(2026-06 起冻结), 后续修改实际发生在 FastSim 工作流; 此处纳入 2026-08-18 在用工作树版本作为唯一信源, 经 TAOGEN_SHARED=<GEM5>/taogen/shared 供编译期 include

patches.note: 上游 tracked 文件的合并 diff, 已包含 buffer TSO 的上游文件改动(生产树默认 serial)
Register isolated opt-in Python classes; legacy memory, X86Board and HBM unchanged.
MESI directory clean-fetch IM remains functionally readable from authoritative memory; timing transitions and dirty/DMA permissions unchanged.

patches.applies_with: git apply -p1 after existing collection hooks
patches.note: Functional actual-walk metadata and Request/DynInst fragment transport; no timing/cache outcome input.

tso-buffer.note: reference-only: buffer TSO 改动已并入 0001 合并补丁, 请勿在 baseline 之上重复 apply, 会 double-count。仅当需要把 buffer 从 baseline 拆出为可选叠加时使用。

artifact.note: 参考指纹; 跨机器/编译时间戳可能不同, 权威判据以身份门禁为准

verify.reconstruct: 上游 c8222cc + overlay + 按 apply.patches 顺序应用 0001、0002、0003；新增大内存文件须匹配 features.x86_large_memory.overlay_files；完整采集源码一致性另行比对生产树。

excluded.resources/: 内核与磁盘镜像, 多 GB 运行期输入, 另行分发并按 SHA 锚定

x86_large_memory.checkpoint_note: Binary and runner SHA256 remain part of identity. Preserve frozen old producer for old checkpoints.

dynamic_translation_facts.compression: mapping dictionary + sparse token updates + gzip level1
dynamic_translation_facts.producer_scope: FS successful data translations, including NO_ACCESS; missing facts explicit unknown
dynamic_translation_facts.consumer_status: FastSim mixed-page DTLB consumer not part of this producer change; legacy reader rejects feature9
